name: Laser Profiling
shortDescription: Precision laser cutting up to 5000 x 1500mm in 12mm steel, 12mm stainless and 10mm aluminium.
description: Our Amada LC Alpha IV 4Kw CO2 laser provides precision laser cutting and profiling services for a wide range of materials. With a 5000 x 1500mm bed, we cut up to 12mm mild steel, 12mm stainless steel, and 10mm aluminium, maintaining tolerances as tight as +/- 0.1mm. From simple flat profiles to complex nested components, our laser cutting service delivers clean, accurate parts ready for the next stage of manufacture.

DXF and DWG file formats accepted

name: Folding & Pressing
shortDescription: CNC press brakes from 100 to 220 ton capacity with folding lengths up to 4 metres, plus hydraulic presses.
description: Our press brake department handles folding and pressing operations from simple single bends to complex multi-bend components. Our Amada HFE 220-4 CNC press brake offers 220 tons over a 4 metre bed with 12mm plate capacity, complemented by an Amada HFE 100-3 for smaller work and Barnes (100 ton) and Ward Forsythe (50 ton) hydraulic presses for heavier forming operations. All our CNC press brakes feature back gauge systems for consistent, repeatable accuracy.
capabilities: CNC press brakes up to 220 ton capacity

CNC back gauge for repeatable accuracy

name: Fabrication & Welding
shortDescription: Bespoke sheet metal fabrication with TIG and MIG welding for all metals.
description: From bespoke one-off fabrications to repeat production assemblies, our fabrication and welding department delivers high-quality metalwork across all common materials. Our coded welders are experienced in TIG and MIG welding of mild steel, stainless steel, and aluminium. We fabricate everything from small brackets and enclosures to large structural assemblies, all under one roof. That includes specialist sheet metal welding, from thin gauge stainless steel enclosures to heavy gauge mild steel structures, using TIG, MIG or spot welding to suit the material and application.
capabilities: Mild steel, stainless steel, and aluminium

name: CNC Machining
shortDescription: Computer-controlled precision machining from prototype to full production runs.
description: Our CNC machining department provides precision computer-controlled manufacturing for components requiring tight tolerances and excellent surface finishes. We mill on our XYZ 710 and XYZ 560 vertical machining centres and DMG Mori Milltap 700, and CNC turning is carried out by our sister company RJ Waller Engineering on seven CNC lathes in Stanford-le-Hope. We machine steel, stainless steel, aluminium, brass and engineering plastics, from single prototypes to production batches.

name: CNC Turning
shortDescription: CNC turning on seven CNC lathes, including sliding-head work, through our sister company RJ Waller Engineering in Stanford-le-Hope.
description: CNC turning for Romark customers is carried out by our sister company, RJ Waller Engineering, a CNC machine shop also based in Stanford-le-Hope. Its seven CNC lathes cover everything from simple bushes and spacers to complex turned-and-milled parts: a Star SR-32J sliding-head lathe for small, precise parts in volume, a Doosan Lynx with Y axis and sub-spindle, an Emco with driven tooling, and further 2-axis CNC lathes. Send your turned parts with the rest of your job and we will manage it as one order, or contact RJ Waller directly.

name: CAD Design
shortDescription: Full CAD capabilities with Solidworks, AutoCAD, and Rhino3D for 2D and 3D design.
description: Our in-house CAD department provides full design capabilities using Solidworks, AutoCAD, and Rhino3D. Whether you need a concept developed from a sketch, an existing design modified, or full production drawings created, our designers work closely with our workshop to ensure every design is optimised for manufacture. We can work from your files, sketches, or even sample components. We also develop accurate flat patterns (blanks) for sheet metal parts from your 3D models, calculating bend allowances so blanks fold to your finished dimensions first time and waste less material.
